title: Questions 161-164 refer to the following text-message chain.
passage_1:
Nadia Okoro (2:15 P.M.)
Would it be possible to make the central display case for the Harlow Museum project about 25 percent wider?

Simon Achterberg (2:17 P.M.)
Why? We have a fixed budget for the display cases, as you know.

Nadia Okoro (2:18 P.M.)
I found a supplier selling ready-made panels that cost much less than the custom boards we first planned to use. The problem is that they only come in one size, so the case has to be wider to hold them.

Petra Lindgren (2:23 P.M.)
I just came off the phone with Ashfield Fittings. They can’t send the full number of display stands we ordered because of a shipping delay. So we will have to make the stand area along the east wall smaller, and that will leave exactly the extra space Nadia needs.

Simon Achterberg (2:25 P.M.)
Understood. Nadia, could you update our plan for that part of the gallery before our client meeting tomorrow morning?

Nadia Okoro (2:26 P.M.)
That works for me. My site visit ends at four o’clock, so I’ll go back to the office and finish it by tonight.
